name: dimixkoj-construction-desktop
description: Separate offline-first ConFlow 1 and BuildFlow 1 Windows desktop apps

scripts.start:conflow: npm run build:web && cross-env APP_VARIANT=conflow electron .
scripts.start:buildflow: npm run build:web && cross-env APP_VARIANT=buildflow electron .
scripts.dist:conflow: npm run build:web && cross-env APP_VARIANT=conflow electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:buildflow: npm run build:web && cross-env APP_VARIANT=buildflow electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:both: npm run dist:conflow && npm run dist:buildflow
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run build:web && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
